title: 硝子の皮膚、空白の書簡
author: 御堂 レン

en.title: Glass Skin, The Blank Letter
en.premise: Living a quiet life alone in a mansion surrounded by mirrors, the protagonist accidentally discovers 'lost letters' left behind by his late wife. Within them lies a terrifying confession: that 'something that is not me,' lurking inside the mirrors, is slowly encroaching upon reality. As a fatal discrepancy begins to emerge between his reflection and his actual movements, his perception of reality starts to warp. In the end, which 'self' is truly peering into the mirror?

zh.title: 玻璃之肤，空白书简
zh.premise: 在被镜子环绕的宅邸中独自过着宁静生活的主人公，偶然发现了亡妻留下的“失踪信件”。信中记载着令人毛骨悚然的告白：潜伏在镜中的“非我之物”，正在一点点侵蚀现实。随着镜中的影像与现实的动作开始出现致命的偏差，主人公的认知也逐渐扭曲。究竟，正在凝视镜中的，又是哪一个“我”呢？
